decision: 5 Second time penalty (2 penalty points imposed, total of 3 points in the 12 month period)
event_name: Time 15:14 70TH ANNIVERSARY GRAND PRIX 6 – 9 August 2020 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Left the track and Re-joined the track in an unsafe manner at turn 15
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV Article 2 of the FIA International Sporting Code and or Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence. From track CCTV, broadcast and in-car cameras, as well as data from the loop at Turn 15 that indicated that Magnussen left the track. Latifi was making a pass on the inside of Magnussen at Turn 15. The Stewards determined that at the exit of the corner, Magnussen left the track unnecessarily and then re-joined the track aggressively, striking Latifi's car. Compounding this the Stewards felt that by leaving the track Magnussen was able to maintain his position.
rules_referenced: Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 20 Re Joined The Track In An Unsafe Manner
to: The Team Manager, Haas F1 Team
